Title: Online Tournaments and Official Constructed Ranking

Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
There is any chance to VEKN allow constructed online tournaments valid to official ranking during this quarantine times?

I want to keep my playgroup active and make tournaments is good to it. I also can offer prize and send it by post office.

Also would be nice if VEKN/BC create some guidelines to how property run those tournaments if they are allowed.

Fernando Cesar - Sydnelson
LackeyCCG and OCTGN VtES Mantainer

Prince of Rio de Janeiro

Powerbase Rio de Janeiro

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Sure. You can enter those results but you must specify in the event name that it's "ONLINE".
Later, we'll be able to move them to a brand new ranking, or leave them as is.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Organizers now have the possibility to directly flag their tournament as ONLINE. It replaces the venue.

Online tournaments will appear in red in the calendar.

Please note that from now on National Championship and Continent Championship cannot be played Online -- you'll have to wait until the pandemic is over (this does not apply to past events).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
